sara: Heads up — FinBank POC is hitting lots of 5xxs during a ramp. Demo tomorrow morning. They see mostly 503/504 and some 500s. Can we triage? @jin @oliver cc sales_engineering

matt: On it. Do you have a request-id + sample payload or timestamp range? Also what QPS/ramp pattern did they run?

sara: Request id: r-0a9f3d2c. Ramp was synthetic: 200 -> 2k RPS over 8 minutes, lots of parallel small prompts. Sample curl we ran:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-large","input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":512}'```We scrubbed PII.

deploy-bot: autoscale-events: [2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] scale-up request for pool-prod-gpu-1 -> +8 instances (initiated) [2026-03-15T10:13:20Z] scale-up completed +2 instances (partial) [2026-03-15T10:14:05Z] backlog peaked 1.8k reqs. Cold-start latency observed 30-60s.

jin: Thanks. Looks like autoscale couldn't converge fast enough — partial scale completed while backlog stayed high. Also seeing model instance OOM retries on rw-gpt-large which cause 500s. Immediate mitigations: 1) Route traffic to a compatible smaller variant (rw-gpt-medium or rw-gpt-medium-quant) to reduce OOMs. 2) Enable burstpool for demo (short term) or increase reserved capacity for the account. 3) Reduce max_tokens/batch_size at client to lower memory per request.

matt: For the short-term demo fix, can we try route swap + enable burstpool? Also should we enable the fallback policy so requests go to a queued-but-healthy backend rather than erroring?

jin: Yes. Fallback policy exists but currently disabled on this route. I can flip it if infra approves. Potential downside: slightly higher latency but much lower error rate.

oliver: I can apply config. Proposed patch (will do if @matt and @sara confirm):```PATCH /v1/routes/finbank-demo
{ "route":"finbank-demo","model_preference":["rw-gpt-medium-quant","rw-gpt-medium"],"fallback_enabled":true,"burstpool":true }```This will send new traffic to quantized medium first.

matt: +1 from support. Sara, will this be acceptable for the demo output quality?

sara: FinBank okay with slightly smaller model for the demo. They prioritize reliability. Go ahead. Also sales asked about pricing impact if we enable burstpool for a day — rough estimate?

oliver: Burstpool pricing is metered; for a 24h demo spike expect ~$600-$1,200 depending on GPU hours. Reserved capacity is cheaper long-term.

anya: Quick security note — ensure we don't enable any infra debug logs with full request bodies for customer data. If you need logs, request ephemeral access token from user and only share scrubbed logs.

matt: Will open a support ticket and request scrubbed traces. Also include the trace header so eng can replay: add header `x-rw-trace: r-0a9f3d2c` to repro.

jin: I'll monitor while oliver applies change. If error rate doesn't drop within 3-4 minutes, we'll escalate to infra for manual pool warm-up.

oliver: Applying now...```2026-03-15T10:16:12Z PATCH accepted
2026-03-15T10:16:20Z route finbank-demo updated -> model_preference=[rw-gpt-medium-quant] fallback_enabled=true burstpool=true
2026-03-15T10:17:05Z traffic shifted, 95% sessions hitting new model```

deploy-bot: metric-update: error_rate(finbank-demo) 5m avg: 12.4% -> 0.9% after route change. average latency increased 120ms.

sara: Fantastic — error rate under 1% now. Please keep monitoring and confirm for the morning demo. I'll tell customer we stabilized. :thumbsup:

matt: Ticket #SUP-2026-789 opened. Attached scrubbed logs and repro instructions. We'll leave fallback_enabled and burstpool on for 12 hours and then revert.

jin: Noted. For follow-up: recommend they either commit to a small reserved pool for consistent demos or we profile their prompts and suggest quantization/response-length caps to avoid OOMs. Also we should run a short stress test with medium-quant to validate throughput.

sara: Agree. I'll propose reserved capacity to FinBank and share the stress-test plan. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
